summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K to submit its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in authorized and issued share capital for April 2026. The filing details changes in issued shares, including a transfer of 2,280,000 shares from issued to treasury stock, leaving total issued shares at 972,508,041 (of which 949,965,002 are outstanding and 22,543,039 are treasury). No other corporate events, transactions, or special situations are reported. This is a routine administrative filing, not a special situation.
